record.issue_text: add_members silently skips nonexistent usernames and returns success_json even when zero members were added, making success indistinguishable from a no-op

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, usernames are split and each is looked up with `User.find_by_username`; missing users are simply ignored (`if user = ...; group.add(user); end`). Regardless of whether any users were found/added, it still calls `group.save` and will typically render `success_json` (unless validation fails), so a request where all usernames are nonexistent can return success indistinguishable from adding members. This is a real, diff-grounded behavior concern, but the diff doesn’t establish that an error/diagnostic is required by spec, and similar “silent skip” behavior existed previously in `update_patch`.
